name: Peak Near Shackleton (Peak B)
mission_context: Artemis III Peak of Eternal Light candidate; highest topographic relief on Shackleton rim; up to 92% summer illumination
scientific_interest: Exposed deep anorthositic lower crust; direct access to Shackleton 40 K Permanently Shadowed Region (PSR)

name: Connecting Ridge (Site CR1)
mission_context: Artemis III candidate; topographic saddle bridging Shackleton and de Gerlache craters; >100 days summer daylight
scientific_interest: Pristine cryogenic volatile sampling along PSR boundary; primordial South Pole-Aitken (SPA) impact ejecta

name: IM-2 Athena / PRIME-1 (Mons Mouton)
mission_context: CLPS PRIME-1 target; TRIDENT 1-m percussive drill & MSolo mass spectrometer for sub-surface ice mining validation
scientific_interest: Direct volatile extraction demonstration; sub-surface ice abundance mapping at 1-meter depth

name: VIPER Target (Mons Mouton Plateau)
mission_context: NASA VIPER exploration center; wide flat-topped mountain (~6 km relief) with expansive safe landing corridors
scientific_interest: Characterization of four Thermal Stability Zones (Surface PSRs, shallow buried, deep permafrost, dry regolith)

name: Nobile Rim 1 (West Rim Plateau)
mission_context: Artemis III candidate; adjoining Mons Mouton; Earth sits 4°–6° above horizon, minimizing terrain occultation
scientific_interest: Overlap with robotic volatile prospecting; multi-basin ejecta blanket (Amundsen, Faustini, Shoemaker)

name: Faustini Crater Rim A (Site LM7)
mission_context: Artemis III candidate; high western rim ridge overlooking Faustini and Shoemaker cold traps
scientific_interest: LCROSS analog volatile stratigraphy; D/H isotopic ratio analysis to distinguish cometary vs volcanic water sources

name: de Gerlache Crater Rim 1
mission_context: Artemis III candidate; northern rim crest complementary to Connecting Ridge; steep inner slopes
scientific_interest: Sharp volatile concentration gradients between sunlit plateau and permanently frozen crater floor

name: Haworth Crater Interior (PSR Benchmark)
mission_context: Permanently Shadowed Region control benchmark (35-km dia bowl, T = 35–40 K); 0% sunlight year-round
scientific_interest: Traps super-volatile species (CO, CH4, NH3, Ar); pristine chemical record of ancient Solar System impact history
